# jamfplatform_pro_patch_policy (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro patch policy by ID. Surfaces the general settings, including the read-only `release_date` / `incremental_update` / `reboot` / `minimum_os` / `kill_apps` fields returned by Jamf Pro. Scope and user interaction are not surfaced — manage the policy as a resource for that detail.

**Required Jamf privileges**

The Jamf Platform API integration used by the provider must be granted the following privileges:

| Required privilege |
|---|
| `read:pro:patch-policies` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a patch policy by ID. Surfaces the general settings, including the
# server-derived release_date / incremental_update / reboot / minimum_os /
# kill_apps fields. Scope and user interaction are not surfaced — manage the
# policy as a resource for that detail.
data "jamfplatform_pro_patch_policy" "example" {
  id = "12"
}

output "patch_policy_target_version" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_patch_policy.example.target_version
}

output "patch_policy_kill_apps" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_patch_policy.example.kill_apps
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Patch policy ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `allow_downgrade` (Boolean) Whether installing the target version is allowed when a newer version is present.
- `distribution_method` (String) How the patch is delivered (`selfservice` or `prompt`).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the patch policy is enabled.
- `incremental_update` (Boolean) Whether the target version's patch definition is an incremental update.
- `kill_apps` (Attributes List) Applications the patch definition closes before installing the target version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kill_apps))
- `minimum_os` (String) Minimum macOS version required by the target version's patch definition.
- `name` (String) Display name of the patch policy.
- `patch_unknown` (Boolean) Whether computers with an unknown installed version are patched.
- `reboot` (Boolean) Whether installing the target version requires a reboot.
- `release_date` (Number) Release date of the target version's patch definition (Unix epoch in milliseconds).
- `software_title_configuration_id` (String) ID of the patch software title configuration this policy deploys.
- `target_version` (String) The software version this policy deploys.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--kill_apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kill_apps`

Read-Only:

- `kill_app_bundle_id` (String) Bundle identifier of the application closed before patching.
- `kill_app_name` (String) Display name of the application closed before patching.
